en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara, from Humran, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [6:2] then He Decreed a term; and there is a term Named with Him.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘These are two terms – A Determined term and a suspended term’.
